Review the selected rows and eligible staged edits in the Preview tab. Click Process and choose the target. Comparison tree The tree has these top-level groups: Template Parameters, Model Categories, Annotation Categories, Analytical Model Categories, Imported Categories, Filters, Filter Overrides, Revit Links, Worksets and Design Options. Control Effect Search box Filters rows by name. Filter Limits the rows by configuration (see below). Select Left / Select Right Selects all differing rows shown by the current search and filter, taking the value from that side. Wipe Clears all selections and conflict state. Filters are kept. Reset Resets the search, the view filter and the conflict filter. Expand/collapse button Expands or collapses all groups. Show: All, Conflicts, Success After Process, shows all rows, only rows that failed to apply, or only rows that applied. Context menu Select from Left (with children), Select from Right (with children), Clear selection (with children), Edit Override..., and for Revit links Open Revit Link Settings... and Copy Revit Link Settings To.... A category row or a Filter Overrides row is configured in a template when that template hides it or overrides any of its graphics. A Template Parameters row is configured when the template includes the parameter. The Filter modes are: Configured (default): rows configured in either template. Configured in Left and Configured in Right: rows configured in that template. Rows that are not category, filter-override or template-parameter rows are always shown. Select Left and Select Right select every differing row that the filter and search show. Under Configured in Left, Select Left can therefore select a row that both templates hide when only Right overrides its graphics. Processing that row to the right template keeps it hidden and clears those overrides. Process Process applies the selected rows and the eligible staged edits in one batch. A staged edit is eligible when its row has a selected side and that side is the edited side, or when its row is not in the current comparison. An edit on a visible row with no selected side, or with the other side selected, is not applied. The dialog asks Apply changes to: Option Effect Overwrite <Left name> Writes the selected values into the Left template. Overwrite <Right name> Writes the selected values into the Right template. Create Merged Template Creates a new template named in Template Name:. The name is required. A merged template starts as a copy of the Left template, so settings VTC does not compare, such as the view scale, keep the Left values. Use Swap to choose the other base. For a row that has a selected side, the target takes that side's value. When the selected side lacks the setting (it is absent there), the row in the target is reset to its default, instead of keeping the base value. This applies to categories, worksets and Revit link settings. A setting that cannot be applied is reported as a conflict, and the others are applied. Any other failure undoes the whole batch. Overwriting a template is one undo entry. Create Merged Template is one undo entry named Create Merged View Template. If it fails, no template remains, so you can retry with the same name. Imported categories Imported categories (DWG, DXF and other imports) appear under their own Imported Categories group. They use the same compare, edit, preview and process flow as other categories. Revit links Revit link settings appear under Revit Links, grouped by link. Type-level and instance-level link targets are listed separately. VTC lists only the settings that the running Revit version lets add-ins both read and write: Visibility Mode, Linked View, Filters, Nested Links, Object Styles, Color Fill, View Range, Phase, Phase Filter, Detail Level, Discipline. VTC matches links between the two templates by link name. If two links have the same name, VTC stops with an error. Action Effect Open Revit Link Settings... Opens Native Revit Link Settings for one link target. The window always lists all supported settings of that target, even if you opened it from one row. Apply to Template writes the selected settings; it is one undo entry. Copy Revit Link Settings To... Copies the supported settings to other link targets. Linked View, Phase and Phase Filter are matched by name in the target linked model. If the name is unavailable because the linked document is unloaded, the raw id is reused only when source and target reference the same linked model. The copy is one undo entry. A target that cannot accept the settings is reported and the others are copied. Any other failure leaves every target unchanged. Loading a saved template from the library also remaps Linked View, Phase and Phase Filter by name in the target linked model. If the saved name is not found there, the setting fails with a not-found error. If the snapshot holds no name (the linked document was unloaded), the stored id is reused. When only one template contains the link row, VTC uses that template. When both do and you have not selected a side, VTC asks which template to use. Library The Library tab saves template snapshots to disk and applies them back to a template. Save Template > Left Template, Right Template or Merged Template. An optional name field sets the saved name. When blank, the source template name is used. Load applies the selected saved template to the side chosen in Load to:. It first asks for confirmation, because it overwrites the template's settings in Revit. A delete button removes the selected saved template, and a refresh button reloads the list. Snapshots are stored under %APPDATA%\DBTools\Cache\VTC\. VTC creates the folder on the first save. Saved names ignore case and surrounding spaces. Saving under an existing name asks Replace saved template 'X'?; Cancel saves nothing. If VTC cannot check the name, or another Revit session saves that name during your save, the save fails and nothing is overwritten. A snapshot that is incomplete or malformed fails to load with a storage error. VTC does not repair or migrate it. If a save or delete succeeds but the list cannot refresh, VTC shows a warning that names the template. A save or delete that fails shows an error. Result Process, Apply to Template and Copy Revit Link Settings To... each make one undo entry. VTC reports each result in an alert titled View Template Comparer. Rows that failed to apply are conflicts; after Process, Show: Conflicts lists them. Messages Message Meaning No view templates found in the document. The project has no view templates. VTC does not open. Select two templates to compare first. Left or Right is not selected. Select at least one setting or make a local override edit before processing. Process has nothing to apply. Created merged template '<name>'. <n> operations completed. Create Merged Template finished with no conflict. Applied changes to '<name>'. <n> operations completed. Overwrite finished with no conflict. ... <n> operations succeeded and <n> conflicts were reported. Some rows failed to apply. Use Show: Conflicts. ... No operations succeeded and <n> conflicts were reported. No row was applied. Pending edits cleared because the template pairing changed. Changing Left or Right discarded staged edits. Pending edits cleared because the comparison was rebuilt. Refreshing the comparison discarded staged edits. Pending edits cleared during selection wipe. Wipe discarded staged edits. No category override data is available on the <Left/Right> side for this row. The row cannot be edited on that side. This Revit link exists on both Left and Right. Choose which template should <action>. Choose the template for a link command. Select a specific Revit link row or setting to open. Open Revit Link Settings... needs a link row.
